usage: arb-engine record [-h] [--sport SPORT] [--every EVERY] [--hours HOURS] [--once] [--books]
                         [--db DB] [--venues VENUES] [--markets MARKETS] [--contracts CONTRACTS]
                         [--target-margin TARGET_MARGIN] [--gold]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sport SPORT
  --every EVERY         seconds between scans (default 300)
  --hours HOURS         stop after this many hours (default: run until Ctrl-C)
  --once
  --books               fetch depth for candidates (slower, sized arbs)
  --db DB
  --venues VENUES
  --markets MARKETS
  --contracts CONTRACTS
  --target-margin TARGET_MARGIN
  --gold
